Taylor S.: Heads up — Helix Financial sent a security questionnaire asking for KMS operation evidence, RBAC change audit, and proof of vuln triage for last incident. Can we map what we can hand over without leaking PII or key material?
Ibrahim N.: We can provide KMS operation logs (key_id, op_type, request_id, ts), rotation events, and key metadata (algorithm, protection level). No private key material.
Clara P.: Also include RBAC snapshots + change history. We have the `rbac-snapshot` tool that can output time-bounded diffs. Suggest 30/90/365 day options.
Ravi K.: For vuln triage, we can export the incident timeline, CVE refs, PRs that patched it, and remediation verification checks. Redact reporter emails.
devops-bot: Build hint: `rbac-snapshot --tenant helix --window 90d --out helix-rbac-90.ndjson`
Taylor S.: Good. Helix asked specifically for tamper-evidence for exported artifacts. How do we sign bundles?
Ibrahim N.: We can produce a signed manifest (ed25519) and include SHA256 for each file. Example manifest line:
```
bundle_id: helix-20250301
files: ["helix-kms.ndjson","helix-rbac-90.ndjson","helix-vuln.json"]
sha256: {"helix-kms.ndjson":"<sha256>"}
signature: "sig-base64"
```
Clara P.: Note on redaction: we replace user emails with user:<uid> and IPs with ip:<hash>. Keep request_ids intact. Document redaction map in README.
Legal Ops: FYI — if Helix requests HSM attestation certificates, loop in cloud provider and contracts. We'll need the chain for external disclosure.
Ravi K.: For incident proofing, include timeline with correlating request_ids. Sample event (ndjson):
```
{"ts":"2025-02-18T03:22:10Z","evt":"auth.grant","actor":"svc-transactioner","request_id":"req-1234","role_change":"added:read_only"}
```
Taylor S.: Streaming vs snapshot — Helix prefers SIEM ingest. We support per-tenant syslog, Kafka, or S3 delivery with lifecycle policies. Need to confirm retention they require.
Ibrahim N.: Retention note: default audit retention 180d. We can extend for enterprise with export jobs or long-term S3 buckets (cost applies).
Clara P.: Action list: (1) Ibrahim — generate sample signed bundle + verification script, (2) Ravi — produce vuln triage export for last incident, (3) Taylor — draft redaction README and retention options.
Ibrahim N.: I can have sample bundle and verify script by tomorrow AM.
Ravi K.: Triage export ready by EOD. Will redact reporter PII.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare an HSM attestation response template in case they escalate.
Taylor S.: Great. tagging @solutions-eng and @account-team to align on ask. When artifacts uploaded, mark with tag `sq-evidence/helix` and move to /run/evidence/helix/2025-03-01/ :thumbsup:
devops-bot: Reminder: evidence builder v2 available — `devops-bot build --tenant helix --window 90d --sign`
Taylor S.: thanks — closing thread once bundle is uploaded.
